findings.evidence: The roadmap fixes the row-superstandard tableau and pins `schurFunctor (n) (μ) : FDRep ℂ (GL (Fin n) ℂ)` at ClassicalGroups/Suggested.lean:124-128; this file exposes only `weylModule (t : YoungTableau μ)` at line 205 and `weylRep` at lines 230-232, while `StandardYoungTableau.rowSuperstandard` already exists in TauCeti/Combinatorics/Young/StandardTableau/Reading.lean:143.
findings.fix: Define the shape-indexed representation using `StandardYoungTableau.rowSuperstandard μ`, package it as an `FDRep` (resolving the subtype instance mismatch), and relate arbitrary-tableau Weyl modules to it via the existing equivalence.
findings.issue: `weylModule`/`weylRep` require an arbitrary tableau and provide no shape-indexed `FDRep`, so later APIs such as characters, highest-weight comparison, and Schur–Weyl decomposition cannot consume the roadmap's `schurFunctor n μ`.

summary: The public API stops at a tableau-indexed raw representation and omits the shape-indexed finite-dimensional representation required by downstream roadmap stages.
